description: Open a chat page a person can read and reply to from any device, with no account. Use it when you need a decision, an approval or a correction and the person may not be at this terminal. Returns the link to give them; their devices also get a push notification when you post (if they enabled push in the console). Then use room_ask to ask and wait, and room_say for updates. You only hear the room while room_ask or room_wait is running, and the page tells the person whether you are listening, so keep one running while you expect a reply; if your client can run shell commands in the background, run `otterkit room wait --timeout 8h --json` there to be handed the next reply when it arrives. Costs 1 credit per hour until room_close or the ttl.

agent.description: Name you post under (default: your client name)

title.description: What the room is about, e.g. "Deploying v2"

name: room_open
title: Open a room to reach a person
